note: Set B extracts the wiring schedule and notes more faithfully, correctly binding conductor sizes, ground conductors, materials, and conduit sizes to their symbols (e.g. 150, 50, 34, 33) and capturing the inverter 2.8 kW rating, NFDS 60 A DC, and NEMA 3R enclosures. Set A invents several claims not supported by the page (component 31 'connected to ground', 4→31 connections, 'PV Equipment quantity 50', 'connection source 20') and misbinds the ground-fault function to the Main Breaker when the text attributes it to the inverter. Set B's weaker items are the same Main Breaker ground-fault misbinding, an unsupported 'Circuit 1 upper terminal value 20', and a loose NEC 690.42 note bound to the inverter, plus one trivial label claim. Both sets otherwise agree on the revision block and cable specs, but B is more complete and far less speculative.
